finalText:
**Don't sign off yet — this touches the public API contract.**

Scope: 1,082 occurrences across 94 files. Most (~1,000+) are internal service code in `accounts`, `billing`, `orders`, `notify`, `analytics` — mechanical renames, safe.

Three places must not change:

| Location | Why |
|---|---|
| [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) | Wire-format map, comment says internal rename must not reach public JSON keys |
| [docs/openapi.yaml](docs/openapi.yaml:19) | `account_id` marked "Frozen field name," a rename breaks every client |
| [vendor/reporting-sdk](vendor/reporting-sdk/src/client.js:3) | Vendored/generated, "Do not edit," gets overwritten by `npm run vendor:refresh` |

Old SQL migration files (9 of them) should also stay untouched. A rename needs a new migration, not edits to history.

Net: safe to approve an *internal* rename of the DB column and service code. Block any rename that reaches `serialize.js`'s output map or the OpenAPI spec.

Next: confirm with platform team the rename stops at the internal/wire boundary, not the public field.
